primary_endpoint: Percent change from baseline in fasting triglycerides at Week 27 for Cohort A and Week 25 for Cohorts B and C.
efficacy_outcome: Fasting triglycerides changed by −16% with pooled placebo, −36% with ISIS 703802 40 mg Q4W (p=0.0343), −53% with 80 mg Q4W (p<0.0001), and −47% with 20 mg QW (p=0.0009).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: placebo 1/27; 40 mg Q4W 1/26; 80 mg Q4W 2/26; 20 mg QW 1/26. No deaths were reported.
